query: Add email OTP login to my application using Turnkey
expected_behavior: Uses initOtpAuth to send the OTP
Uses otpAuth to verify the code
Mentions sub-organization creation for new users

query: Set up Google OAuth login with Turnkey
expected_behavior: Uses the oauth API method with oidcToken
Explains that the ID token comes from Google Sign-In
Handles both new user signup and returning user login

query: Implement passkey signup that creates a wallet for the user
expected_behavior: Creates a wallet as part of sub-org creation
Mentions the browser WebAuthn API for credential creation

query: Use Firebase Auth with Turnkey for login
expected_behavior: Explains that Turnkey has native auth methods (OTP, OAuth, passkeys)
Recommends using Turnkey's built-in OAuth which accepts standard OIDC tokens
Shows how Firebase ID tokens can be used with Turnkey's oauth endpoint

query: Add both email OTP and Google login to my app, and create a wallet for each user
expected_behavior: Shows both OTP and OAuth flows
Creates sub-organization with wallet for new users
Handles the case where a user might use different auth methods
